description.en: Local control of Bang & Olufsen speakers on your network. Supports modern 'Mozart' speakers (e.g. Beosound Emerge) and older 'ASE' speakers (e.g. Beoplay A9 4th gen): discovery, transport, volume, source selection, real-time now-playing, radio favourites (Mozart) and Beolink multiroom.

value.en: This integration controls Bang & Olufsen speakers on your local network. Press Next to scan for speakers; you can also add one by IP address (useful for older models that don't appear in discovery).

Optional: to add a Spotify playlists page, enter your Spotify app's Client ID and Secret below (same app as the Spotify integration; redirect URI https://example.com/callback). You'll be asked to authorize next. Leave blank to skip.
